basis_note: Reads across this case's full built chain - DFAPTI (836 evidence items), DFAPTA (22 paths), Lattice Atlas (8 patterns), SHM Gate (6 mechanisms applied, 1 candidate), Temporal Projection Integrity Engine (8 assessments), Enforcement Notice (to the Commissioner of Police, the Minister for Police, LECC and the NSW IPC), and Advocacy Package. This case is a prospective policy audit of a proposed drone-expansion, not a retrospective personal-harm case like this repository's other built cases - several catalogue entries below match differently as a result, and that difference is stated explicitly rather than smoothed over.

functions.name: Enforcement
functions.definition: The methodology produces findings with evidentiary discipline sufficient to route to bodies with standing.
functions.match_note: A submission-ready Enforcement Notice exists, naming the Commissioner of Police, the Minister for Police, the Law Enforcement Conduct Commission and the NSW Information and Privacy Commission, with binding preconditions - published evaluation, published operational policy, published exit criteria, no expansion decision made in their absence.

functions.name: Translation
functions.definition: Converts inaccessible governance documentation into findings legible to the people governed by it.
functions.match_note: AR-003 through AR-005 translate statistical and cost claims ('50% crime drop', 'a fraction of the cost of a police helicopter') into plain baseline-versus-attribution findings; AR-012 and AR-020 do the same for privacy, AI, biometric and data-retention governance.

functions.name: Pattern Detection
functions.definition: Documents a convergence across actors that no single actor can see.
functions.match_note: Lattice Atlas's LP-001 ('Four claim-verification threads share one missing document') and LP-005 ('One acquisition mechanism resolves nearly every other thread') are convergences no single claim-by-claim check would surface on its own.

functions.name: Power Redistribution
functions.definition: Makes investigative power portable to any operator, no institutional backing required.
functions.match_note: Unlike this repository's directly-built cases, this case's initial evidence base was ingested from an external AI research pass, not gathered by a single unaided operator from the start (DEC-0001) - though a later live, this-session evidence-gathering pass (RUN-0009) demonstrates the same capability directly. Mixed origin noted rather than smoothed into a clean claim.

functions.name: Lived Experience Protection
functions.definition: Classifies lived experience as primary evidence; institutional dismissal becomes a finding.
functions.status: Not the central mechanism of this case
functions.match_note: This case audits institutional and petition claims (AR-002, AR-009) rather than centring one resident's own documented harm the way this repository's other cases do. Not claimed as a strong match.

functions.name: Legibility
functions.definition: Makes governance instruments understandable to the people they govern.
functions.match_note: AR-012 (privacy/AI/biometric governance gap) and AR-020 (records retention, secondary use, child and Indigenous data governance) make legible instruments that would otherwise require specialist legal reading to understand.

functions.name: Containment
functions.definition: Names a structural harm mechanism so it can no longer operate invisibly.
functions.match_note: The SHM Gate names 6 mechanisms as operative - Opacity by Design, Narrative Compression, Documented Compliance as Shield, Complexity as Barrier, Definitional Control, and Time as Structural Harm Mechanism - plus one candidate (Standing Without Discoverability).

functions.name: Temporal Inversion
functions.definition: Time loads onto the institution, not the citizen.
functions.match_note: AR-014 (Continuation Beyond the Six-Month Window and Absent Exit Criteria) directly matches: the trial continuing past its own stated window without published exit criteria becomes evidence against the program, not a reason to assume it's working.

functions.name: Reflexive Audit
functions.definition: MAYHEM's own primitives applied to MAYHEM itself.
functions.match_note: This entire case exists because its own externally-sourced evidence base was not taken on trust - every item carries verification_state 'Unverified' regardless of the source's own confidence (DEC-0001), a later run independently re-gathered evidence live (RUN-0009), and a specific wording correction (DEC-0014) reworded a finding from 'politically convenient' to 'widely used' to keep it aimed at the definitional gap rather than at an MP's motives.

functions.name: Impossibility Demonstration
functions.definition: Converts closure of every remediation surface into evidence of structural impossibility of self-remediation.
functions.match_note: The Enforcement Notice's own remedy demands assume remediation is available and achievable (publish the evaluation, publish the policy, publish exit criteria) - the opposite of a structural-impossibility finding. Not claimed.

functions.name: Divergence Preservation
functions.definition: Preserves disagreement rather than silently reconciling it.
functions.match_note: Two contradictions are named directly in DFAPTA path titles and preserved rather than resolved: AR-010 (Reactive-Versus-Proactive Messaging Contradiction, CTR-0001) and AR-011 ('Solely Used for Crime' Versus Multi-Purpose Messaging Contradiction, CTR-0002).

citizen_tools.name: The Evidence Register
citizen_tools.definition: A blank, paper-ready, append-only template for documenting evidence.
citizen_tools.match_note: 836 evidence items - every numbered finding, Question Bank answer, AE acquisition-status entry, and GIPA application from the source corpus, fully atomized, plus a live WebSearch pass run directly by this investigation.

citizen_tools.name: The Advocacy Package
citizen_tools.definition: The complete investigation output combined with recipient guidance.
citizen_tools.match_note: Built and live, naming who to send the notice and six GIPA applications to, how to submit, and how to log responses.

citizen_tools.name: Five-Step Primary Source Verification
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches any person to verify a finding against its primary source.
citizen_tools.match_note: Present in the Advocacy Package, with an explicit warning that this particular register's items are sourced from an external AI research pass rather than direct fetch - so verification against the original primary source matters more here than in a directly-collected case.

citizen_tools.name: Recipient Routing
citizen_tools.definition: Names bodies with standing, their legislative basis, and the remedy addressed to each.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Enforcement Notice routes remedies across four recipients; six GIPA applications are separately routed to NSW Police InfoLink as specific record requests distinct from the governance-level remedy demand.

citizen_tools.name: Lived Experience Documentation Protocol
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches affected people to document their own experience as primary evidence.
citizen_tools.match_note: This case audits institutional and petition claims rather than centring individual lived-experience accounts.

citizen_tools.name: Reclassification Recognition Training
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches recognition of institutional reclassification patterns in real time.
citizen_tools.match_note: Not evidenced - no training artifact in this case's built material.

citizen_tools.name: Institutional Response Log
citizen_tools.definition: Logs every institutional response - date, form, content, classification.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Advocacy Package's logging section provides the template; no confirmed log entries recorded in this repository.

citizen_tools.name: Harm Narration Construction
citizen_tools.definition: Constructs evidence-anchored harm narration for different audiences.
citizen_tools.status: Not built as a repository artifact
citizen_tools.match_note: Not evidenced as a standalone document within this case's built chain.

citizen_tools.name: Onward Training Capability
citizen_tools.definition: Designed to be passed on by anyone who has worked through it.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Advocacy Package is written for a reader with no prior MAYHEM knowledge.

citizen_tools.name: Operator Curriculum
citizen_tools.definition: Trains operators to run MAYHEM investigations across competency grades.
citizen_tools.status: Not applicable to a single investigation
citizen_tools.match_note: This is a methodology-level tool, not something a single case produces.

citizen_tools.name: Paper-Ready Templates
citizen_tools.definition: Working instruments applying the methodology with no digital dependency.
citizen_tools.status: Not distinctly built for this case
citizen_tools.match_note: Not evidenced as a case-specific artifact beyond the general Advocacy Package content.

citizen_tools.name: Non-Allegatory Framing
citizen_tools.definition: Describes system behaviour, never attributes intent or motivation.
citizen_tools.status: Active throughout - with a documented correction
citizen_tools.match_note: DEC-0014 is a direct, on-the-record instance of this tool being enforced: a finding was reworded from 'politically convenient' (motive-adjacent) to 'widely used' (factual), keeping the finding aimed at a definitional gap rather than at the MP's intent.

citizen_tools.name: Federation as Mutual Legibility
citizen_tools.definition: Multiple independent registers whose convergence produces legibility no single one can.
citizen_tools.match_note: This case does not cross-reference another case's register as part of its own findings.

citizen_tools.name: Temporal Accumulation as Citizen Power
citizen_tools.definition: Absence and delay become evidence that strengthens the citizen's case over time.
citizen_tools.match_note: Directly demonstrated by AR-014/Function 8 above, and by the case's own investigation notes tracking a missed self-stated 1 July 2026 decision deadline now several weeks past with no published outcome.

citizen_tools.name: Cross-Domain Pattern Detection
citizen_tools.definition: Surfaces convergence across health, housing, disability and other domains for the same person.
citizen_tools.status: Adjacent match, not a clean fit
citizen_tools.match_note: This case does converge multiple governance domains - policing operations, privacy/AI/biometric law, data-retention governance, and economic/detention-cost modelling - but on one proposal, not on one governed person's experience across systems as the catalogue definition frames it. Noted as a partial, differently-shaped match.

citizen_tools.name: Community Evidence Aggregation
citizen_tools.definition: Multiple people's accounts of the same system, aggregated without institutional processing.
citizen_tools.status: Adjacent match, not a clean fit
citizen_tools.match_note: AR-002 (Petition Provenance) is a form of aggregated community position, but a petition's signatures are not the same as aggregated documented harm accounts under the lived-experience protocol - the match is partial, not exact.

citizen_tools.name: Structural Literacy as Preventative Tool
citizen_tools.definition: Lets a citizen recognise a harm mechanism before it completes.
citizen_tools.status: Active - the strongest match of any built case
citizen_tools.match_note: Unlike this repository's other, retrospective cases, this case is explicitly prospective: it audits a proposed expansion before it is finalised, aiming to surface missing exit criteria and unaddressed governance gaps before the program continues past this point, not after.

citizen_tools.name: Parallel Verification as Democratic Infrastructure
citizen_tools.definition: Any completed investigation can be independently re-verified using the same methodology.
citizen_tools.match_note: RUN-0009's live, this-session evidence-gathering pass is a direct instance of independently re-verifying and extending an externally-sourced register rather than taking it on trust.

citizen_tools.name: Yield Without Enforcement
citizen_tools.definition: Chain completion is determined by yield delivery, not enforcement notice production.
citizen_tools.status: Active - the organising principle of this page
citizen_tools.match_note: This case's DFAPTA, Lattice Atlas, and SHM Gate already deliver legibility and structural visibility regardless of whether the Enforcement Notice or the GIPA applications are ever acted on.

not_claimed: This gate does not claim every catalogue entry above is fully or perfectly delivered - several are marked 'not evidenced', 'adjacent match', or 'partially evidenced' rather than forced into a positive claim.

This gate does not claim intent by Michael Kemp MP, NSW Police, or any other institution or individual named in this case. Every assessment above describes what this case's own material demonstrates, consistent with this case's own non-allegatory framing and DEC-0014 specifically.
This gate does not re-verify the underlying evidence items cited - their verification status remains exactly as recorded in this case's own evidence register.
This is this repository's own reading of the catalogue against this case's material, not a claim of the operator's final or complete assessment.
